title: Large outbound transfer from database server to newly observed host
description: SRV-DB-01 transferred 8.4 GB to 203.0.113.201:443 over 41 minutes. The destination was first observed in the environment the same day. Immediately prior, the svc-reporting service account created a password-protected 7-Zip archive of D:\data\customers, and proxy logs record an 8.8 GB PUT to backup-sync.example. The svc-reporting account had authenticated from a workstation subnet earlier that evening, which is inconsistent with its normal behaviour.

indicators.context: Destination of the 8.4 GB outbound transfer
Consumer file-sync service receiving the archive upload
